div.div: 8 اِيتَزَرَ , (S, Mgh, Msb,) originally ٱئْتَزَرَ, (Mgh, Msb,) and ↓ تأزّر , (S,) or ايتزر بِالإِزَارِ, and بِهِ ↓ تأزَر , (K,) He put on, or wore, the إِزَارَ: (S, Mgh, Msb, K:) اِتَّزَرَ is wrong, (Nh,) or vulgar, (Mgh,) and should not be said: it occurs in certain of the trads., but is probably a corruption of the relaters: (K:) or it is a correct form, [like اتَّخَذَ &c., (see art. اخذ,)] (Msb, MF,) accord. to ElKarmánee and Sgh and others. (MF.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
